text:
maria (Product): Heads up — we're opening limited Dedicated H100v2 pools in APAC this week. Initial zones: apac-sg1 (Singapore) and apac-syd1 (Sydney). Preview rollout starts Thu 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC. This is preview capacity for Dedicated and Private customers. :rocket:

ajay (Eng-Platform): Quick notes — capacity is very limited at first (expect < 50 nodes total across both zones). Reservation is required for guaranteed capacity. We will provide automatic burst for small requests but it's best to reserve for production.

sophie (Eng-SRE): Deploy window scheduled, infra checklist done. We'll add pool tags: `h100v2-preview` and `dedicated-apac`. No infra downtime expected; routing changes are behind feature-flag.

devops-bot: Scheduled change: add 2 H100v2 pools to apac-sg1 and 1 to apac-syd1. ETA: 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z. Change ID: CHG-20260401-8723.

ajay (Eng-Platform): Reservation CLI (preview):
```
# reserve capacity (example)
redwood reserve --region=apac-sg1 --gpu-type=h100v2 --count=2 --term=monthly
```
API payload example: `{"gpu_type":"h100v2","region":"apac-sg1","count":2}`. Note: the API field is `gpu_type`; older tooling may still send `"gpu_type":"h100"` — those will fall back to v1 H100 unless explicitly requested.

maria (Product): Pricing note — preview pricing will be applied: ~+15% to existing H100 rates. This is a temporary preview premium; final pricing for GA will be announced. Billing will show `dedicated.h100v2.preview`.

ops-lead-ryan: Important policy change for reservations:
- Reservation window minimum: 1 month.
- Cancellation: 7-day notice for partial downsizing in preview.
- Priority assignment: customers with active Dedicated contracts > $X/month get first-come reservations.
If you need an exception, ping me directly (@ops-lead-ryan).

sophie (Eng-SRE): Fallback and routing: requests that specify `gpu_type=h100v2` will be routed to h100v2 pools when available. If capacity is unavailable, requests will either queue (if `allow_queue=true`) or fail with `INSUFFICIENT_CAPACITY`. Recommend adding a client-side retry/backoff and specifying a compatible fallback `gpu_type=h100` for critical low-latency paths.

ajay (Eng-Platform): Canary rollout plan: first send only internal prod teams + 10 selected customers. If telemetry looks good (error rate, latencies, KV cache behavior) for 48h we expand. Watch the console dashboard: filter by `gpu_type=h100v2` and `zone=apac-sg1` / `apac-syd1`.

maria (Product): Docs: new section in Console & API docs will land by EOD today with reservation examples, region notes, and known limitations (no SLA in preview, no cross-zone live migration). Link: https://internal.redwood/docs/h100v2-preview (internal).

ajay (Eng-Platform): Known limits in preview:
- Max seq length tuned for 8k tokens by default.
- Quantization profiles are experimental; recommend not enabling quantization for the preview pool unless you own the model testing.
- Autoscaling backfills may be slower while we observe memory/power profiles.

maria (Product): Action items for teams:
1) If you want reserved capacity, file a reservation via the CLI or Console before Tue 2026-03-31 23:59 UTC.
2) Add `gpu_type=h100v2` to your rollout flags if you want to test.
3) For critical workloads, also add `fallback_gpu_types=["h100"]`.

ops-lead-ryan: Oncall & escalation: if you hit `INSUFFICIENT_CAPACITY` during preview and need immediate support, contact #eng-oncall and cc @ops-lead-ryan. For production-impacting incidents we'll prioritize customers with reservations.

ceo-emma: Huge thanks to infra + platform teams for getting this across the line — excited to see APAC customers using newer silicon. Please keep exec updates brief; we'll surface early wins next Friday. :tada:
